title: Pinakbet French Fusion Risotto
description: A unique fusion of Filipino and French cuisine, featuring a flavorful Pinakbet-infused risotto.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the Pinakbet and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the Arborio rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the white wine and cook until the liquid is almost completely absorbed, stirring constantly.
Add 1 cup of vegetable broth to the rice mixture and cook, stirring constantly, until the liquid is mostly absorbed.
Repeat the process of adding the broth and cooking until the rice is tender and creamy, about 20-25 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the grated Parmesan cheese.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
